title: ForgeX Hub v6
features:
FORGE HUB SCRIPT NOTICE

This script is provided for use within Forge Hub.
Functionality is provided as-is and may change without notice.
Use of this script implies acceptance of all operational behavior described below.

FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION

AUTOMATION
The script may perform automated mining actions when enabled.
Mining behavior may include interaction with multiple resource types.
Target selection is determined internally and is not user-controlled.
Hostile entities may be engaged automatically under certain conditions.
Defensive actions may occur automatically based on proximity and timing.

FORGE PROCESSING
The script may complete melting interactions automatically.
Pouring actions may be executed without manual input.
Configuration values related to forge behavior may be stored and reused.

MOVEMENT BEHAVIOR
The script may alter player movement behavior.
Flight-based movement may be enabled.
Collision detection may be disabled.
Instant movement methods may be used.
Automatic movement toward predefined entities may occur.
Movement-related parameters may be modified by the user.

COMBAT BEHAVIOR
The script may execute combat actions automatically.
Attack methods and frequencies may be adjusted.
Blocking actions may be triggered without user input.
Multiple targets may be processed simultaneously.
Combat actions may occur while other automated systems are active.

VISUAL MODIFICATIONS
The script may modify visual rendering behavior.
Certain objects or entities may be highlighted.
Visibility through obstacles may be enabled.
Brightness levels may be increased.
Atmospheric visual effects may be disabled.
Rendering distance may be adjusted.

UTILITY FUNCTIONS
The script may attempt to reconnect automatically in the event of disconnection.
User settings may be saved and loaded automatically.
Idle detection prevention mechanisms may be active.
Visibility-related modifications may occur.
Server transition functions may be available.
The user interface may be shown or hidden using a keybind.

CONFIGURABLE PARAMETERS
Various numerical values may be adjusted by the user.
These values may include offsets, speeds, ranges, timing values, and opacity levels.
All configured values may be saved automatically.

CONFIGURATION MANAGEMENT
Multiple configuration profiles may be created.
Profiles may be loaded or deleted.
Automatic saving behavior may occur without confirmation.
Profile management functionality is limited to basic operations.

USER INTERFACE
The script includes a graphical user interface provided through Forge Hub.
The interface uses a standard window layout.
Features are grouped into categorized sections.
Navigation follows conventional interaction patterns.
Compatibility with mobile devices may be present.

PERFORMANCE CONSIDERATIONS
The script is designed for continuous execution.
Resource usage is reduced where possible.
Movement interpolation may be smoothed.
No guarantees are made regarding performance or stability.

NO GUARANTEES
The script provides no assurances regarding safety, fairness, or compatibility.
The developer assumes no responsibility for misuse or unintended behavior.
Use at your own discretion.
